description: Update an existing invoice schedule by ID.

businessDetails.description: Business details object (name, address, phone, email, website, logoUrl, customValues)

contactDetails.description: Contact details object (name, email, phone, address, etc.)

items.description: Array of line item objects (name, description, quantity, unitPrice, taxes, etc.)

live.description: Whether the schedule is in live mode (true) or test mode (false)

schedule.description: Schedule configuration object (frequency, interval, startDate, endDate, etc.)

termsNotes.description: Terms and notes text displayed on scheduled invoices

title.description: Invoice title displayed at the top of generated invoices

name: crm_update_invoice_schedule
